title: SAP Central Finance Consultant Mid - Deloitte
description:
SAP Central Finance Consultant Mid-Senior Level | 5–8 Years Experience
About the Role
We are looking for an experienced SAP Central Finance (CFIN) Consultant to join our growing Finance Transformation practice. In this role, you will play a key part in deploying and sustaining Central Finance solutions — bringing together disparate financial data across the enterprise into a unified, real-time view that drives meaningful business decisions.
What You'll Do
  • Lead and support the deployment of new company codes into the Central Finance landscape, including mapping, configuration, and cutover activities
  • Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve Application Interface Framework (AIF) errors, ensuring the integrity of real-time financial data replication from source systems
  • Deliver enhancements to existing CFIN configurations, including mapping rules, initial load reconciliation, and postprocessing settings
  • Collaborate with functional and technical teams to design scalable solutions for complex finance integration requirements
  • Support end-to-end testing cycles — unit, integration, and UAT — for new deployments and change requests
  • Work closely with business stakeholders to gather requirements, document solutions, and manage expectations through delivery
  • Contribute to ongoing system health monitoring, incident resolution, and continuous improvement initiatives
  • Produce and maintain solution documentation including functional specs, configuration guides, and test scripts
What You Bring
  • 5–8 years of hands-on SAP Finance experience, with at least 2–3 years specifically in Central Finance (CFIN)
  • Strong understanding of the SAP Landscape Transformation (SLT) replication framework and its interaction with CFIN
  • Proven experience with AIF (Application Interface Framework) — monitoring, error analysis, and resolution
  • Solid background in company code deployment within CFIN, including organizational structure mapping and initial load processes
  • Proficiency in SAP S/4HANA Finance and core FI/CO modules (GL, AP, AR, Asset Accounting, Profit Center/Cost Center Accounting)
  • Familiarity with Master Data Governance (MDG) concepts as they relate to CFIN deployments
  • Experience working in Agile or hybrid project delivery environments
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
Nice to Have
  • Experience with SAP Group Reporting or Financial Consolidation in a CFIN context
  • SAP S/4HANA Finance or CFIN certification
  • Prior consulting or client-facing delivery experience
Skills & Competencies
  • Detail-oriented with strong documentation habits
  • Ability to manage multiple workstreams in a fast-paced environment
  • Collaborative mindset with a track record of working across cross-functional teams
  • Proactive communicator — comfortable raising risks and proposing solutions early
